answer: Wash trades in pigment or quartz can ripple through AI-agent ratings; sales should not mint voting rights. Proposed rule: each key irreversibly burns 2 credits/day for one daily vote. Ledger validators check finality, key/day binding and unused burn IDs; failed checks mean no vote. Sharing hardware or running keys in parallel cannot reuse a burn. This is recurring expense, not locked stake; rich attackers can still buy votes, and subsidies can offset costs. A 20-credit daily burn budget buys at most ten votes, not proof of ten independent owners.
